candidates.change_summary: Replace owner assignment with assigning the zero address, causing owner to become address(0) and leaving balances[owner] (previous owner) unchanged.
Remove the assignment to balances[owner], so NETM only sets owner (to msg.sender) but does not credit the owner's balance.
Swap the two statements so balances is set for the previous owner (old owner) instead of the new owner, changing which key in balances is written.
Set owner to a different address (tx.origin) instead of msg.sender before assigning balances, altering which address receives the balance.
